Joanna Kaczmarek

Dear partner,
Thank you very much for your message - we are very glad about your interest in our company.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €15.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW.

We have reviewed the delivery performance record and are implementing measures to ensure strict adherence to your schedules.
We can accommodate the requested 35-day lead time, but we must maintain payment terms at 45 days net to support our operations.
With these terms, we are pleased to offer a revised price of €15.80 per unit, which represents a highly optimized cost structure.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €15.80 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our whole team is ready, and we will do everything to make you a satisfied customer.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
